body:
What does it offer?
Mister Experience is the official modpack of the content creator lox_1, creation easier without changing the vanilla experience. The modpack has a lot of helpful utility mods for single-player and creative building. It's built on Fabously Optimised to enhance performance and apply Optifine replacements for resource packs.
All mods are single players mod!

Features
📷 Content Creation 🎥: Record & edit in-game with Flashback, use Camera Utilities for better shots, and expressive emotes to get those funny clips while streaming/recording.

⚔️ Survival Utilities 🪓: Sorting, info HUDs, fast building, inventories tab, quickly swapping tools & items, and many more tools to help enhance your survival experience.

🏗️ Building : 🧱Litematica mods to make your building much easier and focus on creativity.
